jobs.title: Risk Analyst
jobs.location: Al Ruways Industrial City, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
We Are Hiring: Risk Analyst Position: Risk Analyst

We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive Risk Analyst to help identify, assess, and monitor potential business and financial risks. The ideal candidate will support risk management activities and provide insights to improve business decisions and organizational performance.
Key Responsibilities

Identify and assess potential financial, operational, and business risks.
Analyze data and prepare risk assessment reports.
Monitor risk indicators and evaluate potential threats.
Support the development and implementation of risk management strategies.
Conduct research on market trends and industry developments.
Maintain risk databases, records, and documentation.
Assist with internal reviews, audits, and compliance activities.
Collaborate with different departments to identify and manage risks.
Recommend improvements to existing risk management procedures.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.
Ability to interpret financial information and business data.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Good written and verbal communication abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Previous experience in risk analysis, finance, or data analysis is an advantage but not essential.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits.
Professional training and development opportunities.
Exposure to business and financial risk management.
Supportive and collaborative working environment.
Opportunities for career advancement.
Flexible working arrangements where applicable.

Interested candidates are welcome to apply!
